question: A fruit seller has 24 kg apples worth ₹3,600. He sells 12 kg apples at a gain of 20% and the remaining at a loss of 10%. Find his gain or loss (in ₹).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total CP = 3600 for 24 kg ⇒ CP per kg = 150

First 12 kg at 20% gain ⇒ SP/kg = 150 × 1.2 = 180

SP₁ = 12 × 180 = 2160

Next 12 kg at 10% loss ⇒ SP/kg = 150 × 0.9 = 135

SP₂ = 12 × 135 = 1620

Total SP = 2160 + 1620 = 3780

Profit = 3780 − 3600 = 180

**∴ Answer = ₹180 profit**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total apples = 24 kg, Total cost = ₹3600

Sold 12 kg at 20% gain, remaining at 10% loss

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (1 ± % change)

**Calculation:**

⇒ CP per kg = 3600 ÷ 24 = 150

⇒ First 12 kg:

SP = 150 × 1.2 = 180 per kg

Total = 12 × 180 = 2160

⇒ Next 12 kg:

SP = 150 × 0.9 = 135 per kg

Total = 12 × 135 = 1620

⇒ Total SP = 2160 + 1620 = 3780

⇒ Profit = 3780 − 3600 = 180

**∴ The correct answer is ₹180 profit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unitary Method

Find cost per kg first

Profit/Loss

Apply % separately on each part

Total Comparison

Compare total SP with total CP

Key Insight

Split quantities before applying %
